items.text: The goal is a high-value skill portfolio that compounds instead of resetting, unlocking high income opportunities and moving you toward earlier financial freedom instead of staying one semester away.
It fits the moment right after a direction is roughly picked, when a stronger, higher-income skill portfolio and earlier financial freedom depend on execution, not on choosing again.
